feeds.title: CRICKETher
feeds.description: CRICKETher is devoted to bringing you the latest news and views on women's cricket, from England, and around the world. They care passionately about the women's game and we want to share that passion.

feeds.title: Emergency Cricket Blog
feeds.description: Emergency Cricket Blog was started in response to limited statistical coverage of women's cricket on mainstream cricket sites.

feeds.title: Female Cricket
feeds.description: Female Cricket is the worlds first website dedicated entirely to covering everything related to women's cricket including Live Scores, Latest News, Fixtures, Results, Interviews & Match Reports

feeds.title: Fierce Girls Cricket Blog
feeds.description: Fierce Girls Cricket Blog covers topics such as health and wellness for young females, sports articles, education and mental health. It primarily targets girls aged between 8-16. Fierce Girls Cricket provides female inspired equipment and accessories that allows girls to express themselves whilst playing the game they love.

feeds.title: Women's Cricket Blog
feeds.description: Women's Cricket Blog publishes expert & informed news, views and comments on women's cricket around the world. ODI, T20, international, regional, club, fixtures, results and reports - all things women's cricket.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Women's cricket
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest women's cricket news, analysis and review from The Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice. Guardian Media Group is a global news organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism - giving a voice to the powerless and holding power to account.

feeds.title: Women's CricZone
feeds.description: Women's CricZone is a revolutionary website dedicated to providing exclusive insights, news, and interviews from the world of women's cricket.

feeds.title: CricBlog » Women's Cricket
feeds.description: Read articles on Women's Cricket in this segment of CricBlog. CricBlog is a cricket blog, written by Charbel Coorey, a very passionate cricket fan based in Sydney, Australia. This is a cricket blog that aims to cover as much of the great game as possible, with content such as previews, predictions, player ratings and opinions put forward, with no hesitation as it is something I love to do.
